name: Sever Disease / Calcaneal Apophysitis
definition: Traction-related pain at the calcaneal apophysis in growing children, commonly associated with running and jumping sports.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; imaging is reserved for atypical presentations.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent atypical pain needs reassessment for alternative pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi growth-related phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traction-related pain at the calcaneal apophysis in growing children, commonly associated with running and jumping sports.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
